name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, last show you called this a new ceiling for everybody. Does one record actually change how teams draft strategy, or is that just talk?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, it’s more than a stat...it’s a blueprint. Teams see Tass’s seven and know defense ain’t enough; they gotta hunt, pressure, dominate early or get buried.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Now, Cassius, that's a big swing, but a single game, even seven eliminations, doesn't always rewrite the whole playbook for how teams approach the field, right?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Andrew, last show you said a record only counts once if it ain't repeated, but Tass’s seven ain’t just a one-off...it’s a challenge to the whole league’s pace and pressure game.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Here's the thing nobody's said: one game gives us a ceiling, not a trend line.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Tass’s seven is the headline, sure, but what matters now is how Miami’s squads respond...shift tactics, push limits, or risk falling behind as the game turns up.
